Pride events held globally amid rights discussions and detentions

Pride Month events, including marches and flag raisings, took place in various cities like Chennai, Budapest, and Istanbul. In Budapest, the first Pride march since the departure of Viktor Orbán saw thousands participate. Meanwhile, in Istanbul, police detained dozens at an LGBTQ+ event despite a ban, highlighting ongoing tensions surrounding LGBTQ+ rights in different regions.
